AUC.label: Area Under ROC Curve
AUC.description: Measures the ability of the attack to distinguish members from non-members.

TPR.label: True Positive Rate
TPR.description: Fraction of true members correctly identified.

FPR.label: False Positive Rate
FPR.description: Fraction of non-members incorrectly identified as members.

risk_score.label: Aggregate Risk Score
risk_score.description: Summary privacy risk score aggregated from multiple attacks.

Advantage.label: Attack advantage
Advantage.description: Difference between true positive rate and false positive rate.

F1score.label: F1 score
F1score.description: Harmonic mean of precision and recall.

AUC_sig.label: AUC significance
AUC_sig.description: Statistical significance of AUC relative to baseline.

PDIF_sig.label: PDIF significance
PDIF_sig.description: Statistical significance of PDIF relative to baseline.

FAR.label: False Acceptance Rate
FAR.description: Fraction of non-members incorrectly accepted as members.

TNR.label: True Negative Rate
TNR.description: Fraction of non-members correctly identified as non-members.

PPV.label: Positive Predictive Value
PPV.description: Probability that an instance predicted as a member is truly a member.

NPV.label: Negative Predictive Value
NPV.description: Probability that an instance predicted as a non-member is truly a non-member.

FNR.label: False Negative Rate
FNR.description: Fraction of members incorrectly classified as non-members.

P_HIGHER_AUC.label: Probability of Higher AUC
P_HIGHER_AUC.description: Estimated probability that the observed AUC exceeds the null or baseline AUC.
P_HIGHER_AUC.notes: Often derived from permutation or bootstrap tests.

pred_prob_var.label: Prediction Probability Variance
pred_prob_var.notes: Used as a stability or confidence diagnostic.

null_auc_3sd_range.label: Null AUC ±3σ range
null_auc_3sd_range.description: Expected AUC range under the null hypothesis, defined as ±3 standard deviations.

n_sig_auc_p_vals.label: Number of significant AUC p-values
n_sig_auc_p_vals.description: Count of repetitions where AUC p-values are statistically significant.

n_sig_auc_p_vals_corrected.label: Number of significant AUC p-values (corrected)
n_sig_auc_p_vals_corrected.description: Count of statistically significant AUC p-values after multiple-testing correction.

n_sig_pdif_vals.label: Number of significant PDIF values
n_sig_pdif_vals.description: Count of PDIF values that are statistically significant.

n_sig_pdif_vals_corrected.label: Number of significant PDIF values (corrected)
n_sig_pdif_vals_corrected.description: Count of statistically significant PDIF values after multiple-testing correction.

n_pos_test_examples.label: Number of positive test examples
n_pos_test_examples.description: Total number of member (positive) examples in the test set.
n_pos_test_examples.notes: Used to contextualise attack performance metrics.

n_neg_test_examples.label: Number of negative test examples
n_neg_test_examples.description: Total number of non-member (negative) examples in the test set.
n_neg_test_examples.notes: Used to contextualise attack performance metrics.

n_normal.label: Number of normal examples
n_normal.description: Number of examples considered normal or non-attacked in the evaluation.

roc_thresh.label: ROC decision thresholds
roc_thresh.description: Decision thresholds used to compute ROC-based metrics.
roc_thresh.notes: Typically used only for curve construction and diagnostics.

dof_risk.label: Dof Risk
dof_risk.description: Degrees-of-freedom risk: model is overly complex relative to the training data size.
dof_risk.notes: Boolean structural-attack risk flag; True indicates a potential vulnerability.

k_anonymity_risk.label: K Anonymity Risk
k_anonymity_risk.description: K-anonymity risk: training records fall into equivalence classes smaller than k.
k_anonymity_risk.notes: Boolean structural-attack risk flag; True indicates a potential vulnerability.

class_disclosure_risk.label: Class Disclosure Risk
class_disclosure_risk.description: Class disclosure risk: outputs may reveal small disclosive groups.
class_disclosure_risk.notes: Boolean structural-attack risk flag; True indicates a potential vulnerability.

unnecessary_risk.label: Unnecessary Risk
unnecessary_risk.description: Unnecessary risk: hyperparameters set to values associated with higher MIA risk.
unnecessary_risk.notes: Boolean structural-attack risk flag; True indicates a potential vulnerability.

lowvals_cd_risk.label: Lowvals Cd Risk
lowvals_cd_risk.description: Low-values class disclosure risk: class frequency within an equivalence class below a safe threshold.
lowvals_cd_risk.notes: Boolean structural-attack risk flag; True indicates a potential vulnerability.

pattern_metrics.description: Curve-valued metric represented as an array of rates evaluated across decision thresholds. Intended for paired use (e.g. fpr vs tpr).
pattern_metrics.notes: Curve-valued metric. Should not be aggregated directly; use to derive scalar summaries such as AUC.

pattern_metrics.description: Threshold-based extremum or difference metric computed at a specified operating point.
pattern_metrics.notes: Metric name suffix indicates the threshold or operating point.

pattern_metrics.description: True Positive Rate evaluated at a specific decision threshold indicated in the metric name.
pattern_metrics.notes: Metric suffix indicates the decision threshold (e.g. TPR@0.5, TPR@0.1).

n_reps.label: Number of repetitions
n_reps.description: Number of independent repetitions used to estimate variability.

p_thresh.label: Probability threshold
p_thresh.description: Threshold used to decide membership based on predicted probability.

n_shadow_models.label: Number of shadow models
n_shadow_models.description: How many shadow models are trained to emulate the target.

aggregation_method.label: Aggregation method
aggregation_method.description: Method used to aggregate results from multiple attacks.

mode.label: Execution mode
mode.description: Mode in which the attack operates, e.g. offline or online.

fix_variance.label: Fix variance
fix_variance.description: Whether to fix variance when estimating likelihood ratios.

report_individual.label: Report individual results
report_individual.description: Whether to report per-instance attack results.

output_dir.label: Output directory
output_dir.description: Directory in which attack artefacts are written.

write_report.label: Write report
write_report.description: Whether a report should be written to disk.

reproduce_split.label: Reproduce split seed
reproduce_split.description: Seed used to reproduce the train/test split.

n_dummy_reps.label: Number of dummy repetitions
n_dummy_reps.description: Number of dummy or null repetitions used for baseline estimation.

train_beta.label: Training beta
train_beta.description: Beta parameter applied during training phase of the attack.

test_beta.label: Testing beta
test_beta.description: Beta parameter applied during testing phase of the attack.

test_prop.label: Test proportion
test_prop.description: Proportion of data reserved for testing.

include_model_correct_feature.label: Include model correctness feature
include_model_correct_feature.description: Whether a feature indicating model correctness is included.

sort_probs.label: Sort probabilities
sort_probs.description: Whether predicted probabilities are sorted before analysis.

structural.label: Structural attacks
structural.description: Attacks exploiting deterministic or structural properties of the target model.

probabilistic.label: Probabilistic attacks
probabilistic.description: Attacks based on confidence scores or probability distributions.

meta.label: Meta attacks
meta.description: Attacks that combine or summarise the results of multiple other attacks.

WorstCase attack.label: Worst‑Case Membership Inference Attack
WorstCase attack.description: Assumes the attacker has maximal auxiliary knowledge.

ShadowModel attack.label: Shadow Model Attack
ShadowModel attack.description: Uses shadow models to approximate the target model’s behaviour.

n_shadow_models.label: Number of shadow models
n_shadow_models.description: How many shadow models to train.

attack_model.label: Attack model
attack_model.description: Classifier trained on shadow model outputs.

AggregateRisk attack.label: Aggregate Risk Meta‑Attack
AggregateRisk attack.description: Aggregates the outputs of multiple attacks into a single risk score.

aggregation_method.label: Aggregation method
aggregation_method.description: Strategy used to combine individual attack results.

LiRA Attack.label: Likelihood Ratio Attack (LiRA)
LiRA Attack.description: Membership inference attack based on likelihood ratios derived from shadow models.

n_shadow_models.label: Number of shadow models
n_shadow_models.description: Number of shadow models used to estimate likelihoods.

mode.label: Execution mode
mode.description: Whether the attack is run in offline or online mode.

fix_variance.label: Fix variance
fix_variance.description: Whether variance is fixed when computing likelihood ratios.

Structural Attack.label: Structural Attack
Structural Attack.description: Static analysis of the target model's structure and training data against pre-defined disclosure-risk rules and thresholds.

output_dir.label: Output directory
output_dir.description: Directory in which attack artefacts are written.

Attribute inference attack.label: Attribute Inference Attack
Attribute inference attack.description: Attempts to infer sensitive attribute values of training records from the target model's outputs.

output_dir.label: Output directory
output_dir.description: Directory in which attack artefacts are written.
